findings.title: GET /api/cards/[id]/graded burns a Scrydex search credit on every public hit; no freshness gate, no SyncLog metering, no scrydexId write-back
findings.where: design.md §6 (GET /api/cards/[id]/graded route code block); contradicts §3.6 freshness-gate + credit-metering centralisation and NFR-8
findings.fix: Make the graded route obey the same freshness gate + SyncLog metering as every other Scrydex caller. Preferred: route it through pullAndStoreScrydexPrice (return the resolved ScrydexCard from it, or read the stored graded CurrentPrice/PricingHistory). Minimum: on resolveScrydexCard success write Card.scrydexId back, write a SyncLog(job="scrydex_history", cardId, credits, status) row, and short-circuit on SCRYDEX_STALE_MS against the newest SyncLog so repeat views within 24h serve stored data. State the chosen policy explicitly.

findings.title: Graded route passes no setCode to resolveScrydexCard, degrading the §3.2a match to the weaker name-only tie-break for the precision-sensitive graded feature
findings.where: design.md §6 route (resolveScrydexCard called with setName only) vs §3.2a match rule (prefer expansion.code === setCode when known)
findings.fix: State where card.setCode comes from for the Scrydex match. Either document that CardSet has no code column so graded matching necessarily uses setName + collector number (and confirm that is acceptable for graded), or derive a set code where possible (e.g. One Piece externalId prefix) and pass it. Make the §3.2a 'prefer setCode' input source concrete rather than referencing a field no caller populates.

findings.title: §3.2a match rule references card.setCode but no CardSet.code / Card.setCode field exists on the verified schema
findings.where: design.md §3.2a step 2 and resolveScrydexCard signature (setCode?: string)
findings.fix: Add one sentence in §3.2a: setCode is optional and currently only derivable for One Piece from the externalId prefix; Pokémon matches run on setName + collector number. Keeps the match rule honest about which branch actually fires.

findings.title: fetchScrydexCardById branch in the graded route returns { card } while resolveScrydexCard returns { scrydexId, card }, a latent shape divergence
findings.where: design.md §6 route (const resolvedScrydex = card.scrydexId ? { card: ... } : resolveScrydexCard(...))
findings.fix: Normalise to a single ScrydexCard | null local: const scrydexCard = card.scrydexId ? await fetchScrydexCardById(card.scrydexId, card.game) : (await resolveScrydexCard(...))?.card ?? null; dropping the mismatched wrapper object.

findings.title: recognize/route.ts listed 'Import unchanged (already correct on mainline)' but the worktree copy differs; instruction is ambiguous
findings.where: design.md §11 'Import unchanged' list; verified by file hash that worktree recognize/route.ts != mainline
findings.fix: Reword §11 to: 'Copy from mainline (the mainline version already reads scrydexResult.cardId); no further edits after import.' so the file is brought over rather than left stale in the worktree.
